korean_variants: 어두운 파편|어둠의 조각|어둠의 파편|다크 슬리버|어둠의 파편(Dark Sliver)
notes: English identifies Dark Sliver as the proper name of a staff (default:16447) and as its standalone item label. Korean 어둠의 파편 is supported by the established base variant. Japanese ダークシルバー and Chinese 暗银/深银 render the phrase closer to “Dark Silver”; English is authoritative for Sliver. Standardize all four keys as 어둠의 파편(Dark Sliver), preserving the staff context.
